default_body.markdown: The Astra Launcher update feed is connected. No newer installable APK has been published yet. This feed will list the ARM64 and ARM32 APK packages when a new GitHub release is ready.

bodies.markdown: The Astra Launcher update feed is connected. No newer installable APK has been published yet. This feed will list the ARM64 and ARM32 APK packages when a new GitHub release is ready.
Feed pembaruan Astra Launcher sudah tersambung. Belum ada APK baru yang siap dipasang. APK ARM64 dan ARM32 akan dicantumkan di sini setelah rilis GitHub berikutnya tersedia.
